dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, international financial bodies, and sanctions policy regarding Syria.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States Executive Directors at the International Monetary Fund... to use the voice and vote of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Updates conditions for waiving and lifting statutory sanctions against the Government of Syria.
dimensions.evidence: The Caesar Syria Civilian Protection Act of 2019... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Involves international financial institution voting and export credit limitation reviews without direct domestic federal spending figures.
Amends existing sanctions legislation, mandates agency reviews, briefings, and international policy instructions.
dimensions.evidence: The Caesar Syria Civilian Protection Act of 2019 (title LXXIV of division F of Public Law 116-92; 22 U.S.C. 8791 note) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Includes provisions with sunset clauses ranging from 2 years to December 31, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: shall cease to be effective on the earlier of... December 31, 2029.

importance_detail.rationale: Reviews banking exceptive relief for the Commercial Bank of Syria, directs international financial institution voting instructions, requires Export-Import Bank reviews, and modifies statutory criteria for lifting sanctions under the Caesar Syria Civilian Protection Act of 2019.
